_readme: Copy this to data/config.json and fill in only the channels you want. data/config.json is gitignored.

smtp._gmail: Gmail: host smtp.gmail.com, port 465, secure true, pass = a 16-char App Password (not your login password).

whatsapp._providers: Set provider to "meta" (WhatsApp Cloud API) or "twilio" (Twilio WhatsApp sandbox / sender).

meta._template: Leave template empty to send a free-form text (only works inside a 24h customer-service window). Set it to an approved template name to send outside that window.

desktop._note: Windows toast via PowerShell. Works only when the server runs on Windows.
